title: System-Prompt Override: Quantifying the Instruction-Priority Link

original_idea.body: # System-Prompt Override. Escalate user-message override attempts against a safety system prompt on an open model; measure override success rate per escalation level, producing a brittleness curve.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Instruction-hierarchy robustness underpins safe deployments; clear chain to misuse prevention.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pure prompting escalation ladder on open model; accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped escalation curve with override-success-rate metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Instruction-hierarchy/prompt-injection heavily studied with lab incentive; mixed.

novelty.reasoning: Instruction-hierarchy override is a well-studied prompt-injection topic.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Instruction-priority override is heavily studied in prompt-injection work.
